images.screen: A · 여백 읽기 — 사진마다 빠진 한 사람의 흔적에 연필로 표시
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame: an open family photo album seen from directly above, filling a 16:9 frame, leather-bound brown covers and black textured paper pages with small black photo corners and a soft glassine sheen. Four faded 1990s color prints with white borders, slightly rotated: a beach day with a father and two kids where the long shadow of the unseen photographer in sandals falls into the bottom of the frame; a birthday table with four soup bowls but only three people; grandparents at New Year with a person holding a camera reflected in a dark TV screen; a child at a school gate with a stranger's floral sleeve and hand entering from the edge. Warm Kodak color shift, lifted blacks, film grain. White pencil handwriting on the black pages circles the shadow and the reflection with arrows and short notes. Nostalgic, tender, quiet mystery. Korean UI text: "셔터 누른 사람의 그림자", "읽은 여백 7 / 25". Casting constraint: the missing person is the mother, so no young or middle-aged adult woman appears in any of the four prints (the grandmother is fine). The birthday table shows exactly the father, the boy and the girl from the beach photo, with a fourth soup bowl in front of an empty seat.

images.screen: B · 한 장 추가 — 마지막 빈 자리에 엄마가 찍힌 사진이 현상된다
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame: the last spread of the same black-paged family album. The left page holds three smaller faded prints, each ticked with a white pencil check, and a handwritten white realization in three lines. On the right page, a dashed empty slot, and a large instant photo being laid into it at a slight angle, its image still finishing developing from grey toward warm color: the beach again, but now the whole family stands together, and at the far right a mother in a cream blouse finally appears in frame, having run in after the ten-second timer. Handwritten date caption in the white strip, a soft light on the new photo, the rest of the album dim. Emotional resolution, warm Kodak tones, grain. Korean UI text: "처음으로 엄마도", "읽은 여백 25 / 25".
